One-shot bitcoin donations are cool but generating regular income is way cooler strategically. Voat needs to diversify its income if it is to last. This was one of the better ideas that happened on the other site and I see no reason to regress back.

So far Voat has these sources of income:

  • One shot donations via bitcoin. PayPal being largely blocked.

That's it, there is nothing else. I would like to see the following added:

  • Gold feature.
  • Memorabilia / Merchandise sales (labor intensive but could be implemented once a year)
  • Opt-in Advertisements (don't pop an artery just yet, I'll explain)

So the opt-in ads work like this: I'm a poor student and I have no money to donate to Voat, so I go into my settings and check

"[x] Show me ads so I can help Voat"

And an ad begins to display on the sidebar. A little counter appears under the ad to show me how much money I've earned for Voat so far. I make up my mind to watch 5$ worth of ads each month, just enough for a gold (if that feature is ever implemented). This I give to a submission I find particularly worthy and Voat gets the money.

The best part is that nobody except me has to see any ads. I watch them because I choose to and I can give up any time I like.

So what could be done with this money?

  • More servers
  • More developers
  • Money to hire lawyers

I imagine these are the most immediate needs. With more money there are even cooler things that can be done:

  • With enough money and devs Voat can become its own CDN ending its dependency to hosting providers.
  • Donating money to Open Source projects and charities. (You must remember the campaign on the other site which ended up donating good sums to EFF and FSF among others) It was the last great thing they did before going downhill.
  • Supporting a marketplace for devs artists etc.
  • Own coin exchange ans so on...
Ads as a personal opt-in for each user.

This is a brilliant idea that could make Voat earn some money in a very unique way. Opt-in ads could also be personalized with categories that each user subscribes to for example health products, food products, gadgets, garments, sports equipment, etc.

Here are my observations on it, based on my life experiences, and why we have to be careful in who and what we classify as an alpha or a beta, even ourselves.

Its all based on freedom, and how we voluntary restrict our freedom.

If you are not careful, you may be faced with a terrible situation, where you may have to chose between your integrity, or your survival.If this happens to you, its because you lost control of your life, and allowed someone to become your master, you have lost your freedom.

A beta, is in a constant situation where they have to involuntary sacrifice something. In say a situation where an employer says : "forge these numbers, or you are fired" a beta, or a false alpha would have to pick between their job, or their ethics.

In fact, their boss would know this, and would know better then to strong arm them. Such is the power of freedom, that even its presence may protect you from oppression.

and this is where the confusion is happening.

The best way to raise and keep your SMV high, is to keep as much freedom and autonomy that you can have.

The problem though, is that being completely free, will raise your smv up to a certain point, then it will start being a detriment. And there becomes a point, were our freedom becomes our master, and we lose our true motivations.

We lift, because we understand that a healthy body will open up more opportunities then being fat ever will.
